system.description:
Signet Ring (Ceremony): When you are wearing a Signet Ring and write any document, you may seal it. If you seal the written document, anyone who receives it will know if it has been opened or tampered with, as well as that the letter comes from the owner of the signet ring.

1 Item Slot (Worn, RIS Passive) · 50gc · Baubles, rulebook p.207
